entries.6decb556ebe42b0c: A company engaged in a contract-closing support business that supports corporate customers such as electricity and gas providers and staffing companies, from customer acquisition to contract closing, on a performance-based fee basis.
entries.775a04ff1ed104aa: This is the single segment of the group consisting of the company and 14 consolidated subsidiaries. To address companies' management challenge of contract conclusion activities, it supports the process from attracting prospective users through to contract conclusion on an end-to-end basis, and operates the business on a performance-based fee model in which compensation arises upon contract conclusion. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥29,100 million.
entries.7bb1d864e77b29b4: The business segment is a single segment: success-support business. The breakdown of revenue of ¥29,100 million for the fiscal year ended March 2026 by domain is energy domain ¥13,853 million, talent domain ¥10,566 million, and new and other domains ¥4,680 million. In the energy domain, it is described as the largest business of its kind in Japan, with more than approximately 900,000 support cases a year in success support for electricity, gas and similar services, and revenue from a major customer group (energy domain; name not disclosed) accounting for 10% or more of revenue was ¥8,549 million.
entries.7c73c7303b2763a3: It is promoting the five-year medium-term management plan "ODYSSEY800," which begins with the fiscal year ended March 2026, and its growth strategy includes making its revenue portfolio more stock-based by raising the ratio of stock-type revenue to shot-type revenue, establishing an overwhelming position in both the existing talent and energy domains, which are its existing businesses, and pursuing M&A aimed at entering new domains that will become the next pillars.
entries.7f52e806453e16d4: Centered on INE Co., Ltd. and Five Line Co., Ltd., this domain provides sales promotion support services for electricity and gas providers. It operates the matching sites 'Enechoisu' and 'Hikkoshi Tetsuzuki.com,' and is also advancing its grid-connected storage station business in this domain. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥13,853 million.
